extracted.intended_audience: fiction authors using AI writing tools (e.g., Sudowrite)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical tips for using AI tools to generate, revise, and refine fiction while preserving authorial voice, consistency, and craft. Covers pre-work (Story Bible), matching AI functions to tasks, and craft-focused evaluation of AI output.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use AI for generating options, not final copy.
rubrics_metrics.description: Use AI to produce alternatives and possibilities rather than accepting its output as finished prose; the author's judgment should refine and select.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat AI output as prompts, raw material, or variations to choose from and edit. Avoid pasting AI text verbatim into your manuscript without conscious author-level revision, because the tool is strongest at offering options and weaker as an authoritative final voice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build your Story Bible first.
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a Story Bible containing character details, worldbuilding, genre conventions, and style samples before heavy AI use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Populate the Bible with character traits, backstory, speech patterns, setting rules, and example passages in your desired voice. Feed these to the AI to reduce drift, maintain consistency, and make prompts more effective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Match tool to need.
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose the AI function according to the task: describing sensory detail, rewriting for alternatives, brainstorming directions, or drafting/expanding scenes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Map functions to needs (e.g., 'describe' for sensory depth, 'rewrite' for alternative phrasings, 'brainstorm' for plot or scene ideas, 'draft' for expansion). Use the right mode instead of forcing one mode to solve every problem.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain voice consistency through customization.
rubrics_metrics.description: Preserve a consistent authorial and character voice by customizing prompts and providing style examples and detailed character entries with speech patterns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the AI with explicit style samples and character profiles (speech quirks, vocabulary, cadence). Use templates or repeated instructions to keep tone and voice steady across AI outputs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adjust creativity settings strategically.
rubrics_metrics.description: Change the model's creativity/temperature settings based on desired fidelity versus novelty (low = close to patterns; high = unexpected).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use lower creativity settings when you need text that closely follows existing voice or constraints; use higher settings to break out of clichés and discover fresh, surprising ideas. Iterate to find the sweet spot for each task.

rubrics_metrics.name: Always read AI-generated passages consciously.
rubrics_metrics.description: Actively evaluate AI output for match to voice, tone, and narrative direction rather than passively accepting it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check for voice/diction mismatches, tonal drift, factual errors, plot inconsistencies, clichés, and places needing pruning. Edit for craft (line-level polish, clarity, pacing) and for authorial intent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sensory depth across all five senses.
rubrics_metrics.description: Aim for sensory richness by engaging sight, sound, smell, taste, and touch in descriptive passages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompt the AI to include specific sensory details. Use sensory prompts to convert telling into vivid showing and to ground scenes emotionally and physically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative pacing.
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitor and control the rhythm of scenes and the movement of plot beats to maintain reader engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use AI to expand or compress scenes, vary sentence and paragraph lengths, and adjust the balance between action, reflection, and exposition. Watch for info-dumps or prolonged inertia.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dialogue authenticity.
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure dialogue sounds like real speech for each character and serves subtext, conflict, or plot (not merely exposition).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vet AI-generated dialogue for distinct speech patterns, believable rhythms, and subtext. Avoid using dialogue to dump backstory; if AI does so, rewrite for plausibility and voice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre conventions.
rubrics_metrics.description: Respect (or intentionally subvert) the expectations and tropes of the chosen genre.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide genre examples in your Story Bible or prompts so the AI adheres to or deliberately plays with conventions. Use genre signals (tone, pacing, stakes) to keep scenes appropriate to audience expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: "Show don't tell".
rubrics_metrics.description: Favor showing through action and sensory detail rather than telling through exposition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prompt the AI to transform telling sentences into concrete images, actions, or dialogue. Use examples of showing from your style samples to guide output.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character voice consistency.
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain distinct, stable voices for each character across scenes and dialogue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Feed the AI clear character profiles (vocabulary, sentence length preferences, emotional baseline). Check outputs for voice slippage and correct inconsistencies during revision.
